courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 液晶空間光調制器
related.transfer: 可遷移「微鏡傾角與照明 f 數」與「亮度鏈、對比與時序量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；液晶空間光調制器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mirror tilt and illumination f-number" and "Flux chain, contrast and timing measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以微鏡傾角、f 數、繞射級與光展量為核心的 DMD 照明、投影與圖樣投射引擎工程；液晶空間光調制器則以反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on DMD illumination, projection and pattern-projection engine design built on mirror tilt, f-number, diffraction orders and étendue; Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators centres on phase stroke, pixel diffraction, liquid-crystal response, lookup-table calibration and system integration of reflective LCOS phase modulators, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「±12° 微鏡傾角與照明入射角」與「平行配向向列液晶層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液晶空間光調制器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「相位誤差預算與熱負載」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence” and “Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Phase-error budget and thermal load", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 雷射散斑抑制
related.transfer: 可遷移「微鏡傾角與照明 f 數」與「亮度鏈、對比與時序量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；雷射散斑抑制的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Mirror tilt and illumination f-number" and "Flux chain, contrast and timing measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Laser-speckle reduction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以微鏡傾角、f 數、繞射級與光展量為核心的 DMD 照明、投影與圖樣投射引擎工程；雷射散斑抑制則以散斑統計、1/√N 多樣性預算、移動擴散片、光纖去同調、等效人眼量測與投影光展量限制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on DMD illumination, projection and pattern-projection engine design built on mirror tilt, f-number, diffraction orders and étendue; Laser-speckle reduction centres on speckle statistics, 1/√N diversity budgets, moving diffusers, fiber decoherence, eye-equivalent measurement and projector étendue limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「±12° 微鏡傾角與照明入射角」與「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雷射散斑抑制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測誤差預算與部分相關」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence” and “Screen roughness and observer pupil”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Laser-speckle reduction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measurement error budget and partial correlation", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scope: 說明反射式液晶相位調制器的用途（波前控制、像差修正、雷射加工）、寬頻鋁電極與特定波長介電多層膜兩種反射層，以及高功率耐受（700 W 級）與每單位面積建議照度；不含像素層級設計資料。

references.titleEn: HOLOEYE Photonics: Spatial light modulators overview
references.scope: 列出 3.74 到 8 µm 像素間距、1920×1080 到 4160×2464 解析度的 LCOS 相位調制器，以及各型號在不同波長的相位行程（例如 2π 於 420–650 nm、2.5π 於 800 nm）；公開規格頁。
references.scopeEn: Lists LCOS phase modulators with 3.74 to 8 µm pitch and 1920×1080 to 4160×2464 resolution, plus per-model phase strokes at different wavelengths (for example 2π across 420–650 nm, 2.5π at 800 nm); a public specification page.

references.title: Meadowlark Optics：1920×1200 空間光調制器規格頁
references.titleEn: Meadowlark Optics: 1920 x 1200 spatial light modulator
references.scope: 提供 8 µm 像素、95.6% 填充因子、各波長液晶響應時間（532 nm ≤ 15 ms、1550 nm ≤ 55 ms）、零階反射率、校正後波前（532 nm 為 λ/7）與區域式電壓對相位校正等公開數值。
references.scopeEn: Gives public numbers for 8 µm pixels, 95.6% fill factor, LC response times by wavelength (≤ 15 ms at 532 nm, ≤ 55 ms at 1550 nm), zeroth-order reflectance, calibrated wavefront (λ/7 at 532 nm) and regional voltage-to-phase calibration.

references.title: Silicon Light Machines：雷射投影顯示的散斑對比抑制（Trisnadi）
references.titleEn: Silicon Light Machines: Speckle contrast reduction in laser projection displays (Trisnadi)
references.scope: 公開技術論文，定義散斑對比、角度／偏振／波長多樣性相乘的縮減因子，並報告光柵光閥投影機以 Hadamard 擴散片把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；課程數值為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Public technical paper defining speckle contrast and the product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity factors, and reporting a Hadamard diffuser that cut contrast from about 70% to 8% on a grating-light-valve projector; course numbers are teaching assumptions.

references.title: Christie：雷射投影技術（RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉）
references.titleEn: Christie: Laser projection (RGB pure laser and laser phosphor)
references.scope: 官方頁面說明 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉兩種投影架構、色域與壽命；頁面未討論散斑，課程以其架構差異說明為何 RGB 純雷射需要散斑抑制。
references.scopeEn: Official page describing RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor projection architectures, colour gamut and lifetime; it does not discuss speckle, and the course uses the architectural difference to explain why RGB pure laser needs speckle reduction.

references.title: Laser Focus World：小型低成本雷射散斑抑制技術
references.titleEn: Laser Focus World: Laser-speckle reduction technology boasts minimal size and low cost
references.scope: 產業報導，描述以電活性聚合物膜與 x、y 電極 90° 相位差驅動擴散片做圓周運動的散斑抑制器；未提供對比數據。
references.scopeEn: Trade report describing a speckle reducer whose diffuser is driven in circular motion by an electroactive-polymer membrane with x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase; no contrast figures given.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 數位微鏡光學引擎
history.text: 1987 年德州儀器的 Larry Hornbeck 發明數位微鏡元件，1996 年 DLP 投影技術商品化，2000 年前後進入數位電影放映；微鏡傾角由早期的 ±10° 演進到 ±12° 與 ±17°，像素間距縮到 5 µm 級。2010 年代起高圖樣率控制器讓 DMD 成為結構光三維量測、光固化 3D 列印、無光罩微影與壓縮感測光譜儀的核心元件，台灣的揚明光學等廠商則專精於 DLP 光學引擎的量產；本課只整理公開的光學設計與量測方法。
history.textEn: Larry Hornbeck at Texas Instruments invented the digital micromirror device in 1987, DLP projection was commercialized in 1996 and entered digital cinema around 2000; mirror tilt evolved from the early ±10° to ±12° and ±17°, and pitches shrank toward the 5 µm class. From the 2010s high-pattern-rate controllers made the DMD the core of structured-light 3D measurement, photopolymer 3D printing, maskless lithography and compressive-sensing spectrometers, while Taiwanese makers such as Young Optics specialized in volume production of DLP optical engines; this course covers only public optical design and measurement methods.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「微鏡傾角與照明 f 數」到「均勻度驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Mirror tilt and illumination f-number" through "Uniformity acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
